k_bank.predicate: K and configuration bank on one accepted descriptor

m_completion_pressure.predicate: M dispatch snapshot and matching successful retirement in the same epoch and PC; completion occupancy at dispatch

apb_direction_wait.predicate: direction and observed wait cycles on one completed APB transaction

recovery.predicate: failed consumed completion followed by successful same-tag new descriptor after invalidation in one epoch

exclusions: Not a full Cartesian outcome or interrupt matrix
Completion pressure is sampled at M dispatch, not assumed stable through retirement
